images.filename: New Plymouth Sugar Loaves from the Breakwater, 1033140, 01.jpg
images.caption: Picture shows a beach scene overlooking the ocean, Four tall rocky land masses rise from the sea at different locations, Towards the centre of the image, in the distance, is a steamboat, In the foreground of the image is a set of concrete steps, with two large metal anchors placed on their sides on the steps, A piece of wood lies to the left of the anchors, and a small pile of metal rungs lie on the second concrete step, towards the centre of the image,
